// diagnostic

E1363

This source declares inline Package facts while `package.jet` also exists.

What

This source declares inline Package facts while `package.jet` also exists.

Why

Jet allows one Package context per project; choosing between two identities would make builds, dependencies, outputs, and authority nondeterministic.

Fix

Remove the inline block or remove `package.jet`, then keep the remaining Package declaration canonical.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1363: tests/ui/inline_package_conflict/stderr.

Error [jet.InlinePackageConflict]: This source declares inline Package facts while `package.jet` also exists.
  --> tests/ui/inline_package_conflict/run.jet:1:1
    |
  1 | package: { name: "inline-demo" }
    | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: Jet allows one Package context per project; choosing between two identities would make builds, dependencies, outputs, and authority nondeterministic.
 Fix: Remove the inline block or remove `package.jet`, then keep the remaining Package declaration canonical.
